title: Lumbar motion segment coupled motions at 80 N / 8 Nm under 0, 2200 and 4400 N preload (3 specimens)
levels: lumbar (3 of the 11 segments; levels not identified)

quantity.name: coupled displacement / rotation at test load
quantity.definition: secondary motion of O (deg or mm) accompanying the main test direction at 80 N / 8 Nm; Loads applied at point O = geometric centre of the inferior end plate of the superior vertebra (midway between palpated anterior/posterior/lateral end-plate margins); inferior vertebra clamped with disc horizontal; displacements/rotations of O from 6 LVDTs (resolution ~0.5 deg, 0.25 mm). Moments applied as pure couples; preload applied axially through O via outrigger cables, hinges and Belleville springs (constant magnitude, not a follower path).

source.authors: Janevic J, Ashton-Miller JA, Schultz AB
source.sample: 3 lumbar motion segments (the only ones completing all 21 tests); human cadaveric lumbar motion segments, all discs Nachemson grade III; mean (SD) disc AP diameter 42.1 (4.2) mm, lateral 58.3 (5.6) mm

protocol.summary: Static test loads in 4 increments of 40 N or 4.0 Nm (each over 5 s, held 60 s) up to 160 N / 16 Nm, under 0, 2200 or 4400 N axial compressive preload; directions in fixed order LLat, CCWT, Flex, Ext, Ant, RLat, Post; 30 s bias load to standardise start near the neutral-zone limit; values read 60 s after the 80 N / 8 Nm increment. Coupled motions from the 3 specimens that completed all 21 tests.
how_to_simulate: Fix the inferior vertebra with the disc horizontal; reference point O = centre of the inferior end plate of the superior vertebra
Apply 0, 2200 or 4400 N axial compression through O (constant direction, vertical) and let the model equilibrate
Apply the test load at O in two 40 N (shear) or 4 Nm (pure moment) increments to 80 N / 8 Nm, with no other constraint on the upper vertebra
Report the primary displacement (mm) or rotation (deg) of O at 80 N / 8 Nm and compare per direction and preload (creep: values at 60 s hold)
protocol.notes: Coordinate/reference: Loads applied at point O = geometric centre of the inferior end plate of the superior vertebra (midway between palpated anterior/posterior/lateral end-plate margins); inferior vertebra clamped with disc horizontal; displacements/rotations of O from 6 LVDTs (resolution ~0.5 deg, 0.25 mm). Moments applied as pure couples; preload applied axially through O via outrigger cables, hinges and Belleville springs (constant magnitude, not a follower path). Elderly (48-83 y), grade III discs; 4400 N tests often stopped early (failures by end-plate fracture); n differs per cell. Flexibility reductions 0->2200 N reported in text (e.g. 4.35 LLat shear, 7.94 Ant shear, 6.06 Post shear, 2.62 flexion, 2.35 extension, 3.35 RLat bending, 4.52 torsion).
